script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

EXT. SUBURBAN STREET - DAY

A sunlit day in the picturesque suburbs. Children play in the street, their laughter echoing off the houses. A father, JOHN, watches from the front porch as his son, MIKE, aged 13, practices baseball in the driveway.

INT. JOHN'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

John, a 45-year-old architect, sits at his desk, staring at a blueprint. His wife, LUCY, enters, carrying a steaming mug of tea.

LUCY
(smiling)
Another late night?

JOHN
(sighing)
Just trying to make our house stand out.

LUCY
John, it's beautiful just the way it is. But if that's what you want...

INT. MIKE'S BEDROOM - MORNING

Mike wakes up early, before anyone else in the house. He's determined to create something of his own. He rummages through his drawers, pulling out some paper and a pencil. He begins to sketch, his ambition clearly visible in the lines.

EXT. MIKE'S SCHOOL - DAY

Mike enters the schoolyard, eager to show his sketches to his classmates. But they dismiss his ideas, more interested in video games and social media. Disappointed, Mike hides his work and joins the crowd.

INT. JOHN'S OFFICE - DAY

John receives a call from the city. His design has been chosen for a new community center. Everyone in the office cheers and congratulates him. John is elated but also reminded of his son's dreams.

EXT. COMMUNITY CENTER CONSTRUCTION SITE - DAY

Months later, the community center is nearing completion. John oversees the workers while Mike, now 14, stands nearby, sketching the progress.

MIKE
(excited)
Dad, this is amazing!

JOHN
(proudly)
Yes, it is. But remember, Mike, success doesn't come overnight. It takes hard work, determination, and patience.

INT. MIKE'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Mike sits at his desk, surrounded by his sketches. He's drawn inspiration from his father's success. He begins to draft a business plan for a design firm, determined to make his ambitions a reality.

EXT. JOHN'S HOUSE - DAY

The family gathers in the living room to admire the completed community center. John looks proudly at his wife, then at his son.

JOHN
(smiling)
We did it, team.

MIKE
(grinning)
Maybe it's time for me to start my own project, Dad.

FADE OUT.

THE END
